skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Attacks a single target with 2 consecutive strikes, dealing 90% ATK DMG per strike.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 2 consecutive strikes, dealing DMG equal to 24% of Genos' Max HP. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the main target and surrounding enemies for 2 turns. [Burn]: Deals Continuous DMG equal to 70% ATK. After casting, Genos loses 70% of Max HP until the end of the current turn.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 2 consecutive strikes, dealing DMG equal to 32% of Genos' Max HP. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the main target and surrounding enemies for 2 turns. [Burn]: Deals Continuous DMG equal to 90% ATK. After casting, Genos loses 90% of Max HP until the end of the current turn.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. After receiving fatal DMG, triggers [Regeneration]. [Regeneration]: While at least 1 ally remains, restores 50% HP before Genos' next action and allows him to continue fighting. Can trigger up to 1 time per battle. When [Regeneration] triggers, deals Extra DMG equal to 160% ATK to all enemies.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. After receiving fatal DMG, triggers [Regeneration]. [Regeneration]: While at least 1 ally remains, restores 75% HP before Genos' next action and allows him to continue fighting. Can trigger up to 1 time per battle. When [Regeneration] triggers, deals Extra DMG equal to 180% ATK to all enemies.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. After receiving fatal DMG, triggers [Regeneration]. [Regeneration]: While at least 1 ally remains, restores 75% HP before Genos' next action and allows him to continue fighting. Can trigger up to 2 times per battle. When [Regeneration] triggers, deals Extra DMG equal to 200% ATK to all enemies.

effects.desc: Deals ATK-based Continuous DMG for 2 turns. Ultimate deals 70% ATK as Continuous DMG, while Ultra-Ultimate deals 90% ATK.
After receiving fatal DMG, restores HP before Genos' next action while at least 1 ally remains, allowing him to continue fighting.
